intro: Shelby County sits just south of Birmingham, with towns along I-65, US-31, and US-280. We buy houses across the county as a cash buyer, not as a listing agent, from the Hoover and Pelham area down through Alabaster and Calera and into quieter parts of the county.

You can sell the house as-is. No clean-out, no showings, and no repair list. We often make a fair cash offer the same day we have looked at the property. Closings usually take as little as 7-14 days, depending on title work, and you pick the move-out date.
